HQ: press calls it a French startup (eu-startups headline 'French DeepTech company Arago'; EE Times 'French Startup'); its careers page lists roles in 'Paris, Tel Aviv'; EE Times says the ~20-person team sits in France, the UK, the US and Israel. Paris is the best-supported city but no imprint states it (medium confidence). Focus: chips are Industrial & Robotics per the brief.
